Subject: IAM evidence request - SSO/SCIM details & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Ceres Health's use cases and compliance requirements. Quick recap from our side and the next steps we agreed on: 

Summary of ask:
- Ceres requires confirmation of current SOC 2 status and date of the most recent audit.
- Need specifics on identity integrations: SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning support, RBAC/admin controls, and audit logging for admin actions.
- You flagged a vendor security questionnaire and proof of controls for data access; we'll initiate that and share evidence.

What Redwood will provide (action items):
1) Share our SSO metadata and SP configuration stub for your IdP (redwood_SSO_metadata.xml). — Owner: Aditya (by EOD 6/15)
2) Provide SCIM provisioning guide and attribute mapping doc (redwood_scim_provisioning_guide.pdf). — Owner: Marissa (6/16)
3) High-level SOC 2 Type II scope summary and auditor name (SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf). — Owner: Marissa (6/16)
4) Start the vendor security questionnaire (we'll send a completed copy and attach evidence links). — Owner: Neha (6/16)

Next steps for Ceres:
- Please confirm the preferred format for SSO metadata (XML vs metadata URL) and the target service account for provisioning (email or team name).
- If you have a template security questionnaire, please share it and we'll return it pre-filled.

Proposed cadence:
- Return evidence by 6/16; follow-up call to review technical items on 6/17 (30 minutes).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our security team: 
- SOC 2: we require evidence that the vendor has a SOC 2 Type II. A high-level summary plus the auditor's name is fine to start; we may request the full report under NDA later.
- SSO: prefer a metadata XML file (we ingest metadata files).
- SCIM: we use SCIM for provisioning; we need an attribute mapping table and confirmation of supported operations (create/update/deactivate).
- RBAC/admin: we need a document that outlines admin roles, separation of duties, and the process for granting admin privileges.

I'll attach our vendor security questionnaire template — please fill in the relevant sections and return. If anything is longer than a page, point us to a drive link.

We can do the 6/17 technical sync at 10:00 AM ET.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Sr. Security Engineer | Ceres Health
security@cereshealth.com

Alex —

Attaching the initial artifacts we discussed:
- redwood_SSO_metadata.xml (SP metadata for SAML integration)
- redwood_scim_provisioning_guide.pdf (SCIM attribute mapping + supported ops)
- SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (scope, auditor, report period)

A few quick notes on the SCIM doc: we support create, update, and deactivate via PATCH/PUT for user resources. The attributes we push by default are: userName, givenName, familyName, emails, groups, and externalId. Provisioning can be scoped to team or org level depending on the configuration.

For RBAC/admin controls: our console has three primary admin roles (Org Admin, Security Admin, ReadOnly Admin). Org Admins can invite users and change billing; Security Admins manage SSO, audit logs, and role assignments. ReadOnly Admins have view-only access to configs and logs. We're attaching the provisioning guide that includes screenshots of the role management page.

If you prefer, we can also host the metadata at a URL instead of sending the file — happy to do that.

Next: Neha will begin filling out your VSQ and link the evidence in Drive by end of day. We'll join the 10:00 AM ET sync on 6/17.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
